payload.title: Research publication pipeline (P1 pre-flight to P8 publish + post-publish)

steps.what: PRE-FLIGHT: slug/WBS free via git ls-remote + registry check; take publish-lock.
steps.why: A registry P0/no-DOI row does not prove the slug is free; two sessions on one RES.*.P8 created duplicates (PUBLISH-LOCK-1).
steps.scope: portfolio-state lock row: session_id + wbs_code + target concept.

steps.what: TITLE-EXISTENCE CHECK: query Zenodo for the exact title before creating any deposit.
steps.why: A PUBLISHED record with the same title on a different concept = BLOCK and reconcile (TITLE-EXISTENCE-PRE-PUBLISH-1, canonical 22044217/22044106 race).

steps.what: SOURCE COMPLETENESS: collect ALL provenance files before deposit.
steps.why: .md/.html/.pdf is MINIMUM not complete provenance (PUBLICATION SOURCE COMPLETENESS).
steps.scope: references.bib, citation-audit.md, PROJECT-PLAN.md, README.md, docs/deep-research.md, artifacts/*, external-search/*, GitHub provenance via related_identifiers.

steps.what: COMPUTATIONAL VERIFICATION: every quantitative claim verified in code, artifacts deposited.
steps.why: Unreproducible tables are a publish blocker (COMPUTATIONAL-VERIFICATION-1, canonical QCA Toy Model v1.0 -> v1.1.2).

steps.what: DEPOSIT: Zenodo deposit with FINAL frontmatter; verify no <RESERVED> DOI and file list matches.
steps.why: Published records are immutable; a placeholder DOI or wrong file list is permanent until a new version (ZENODO-PLACEHOLDER-DOI-1).

steps.what: PUBLISH: publish the record; verify concept DOI + version count.
steps.why: How-to-Cite must cite the concept DOI, not the v1 record DOI (ZENODO-CONCEPT-DOI-CITE-1).

steps.what: POST-PUBLISH ASSERT: frontmatter parity probe (version/date/doi/title all current).
steps.why: The publish flow half-updates frontmatter; 7/7 recently published rows carried stale doi/title (FRONTMATTER-SYNC-PARTIAL-1).

steps.what: R2 MIRROR: mirror to qnfo-releases YYYY/MM/<slug>/ + distribution_status=distributed + r2_path.
STORE SYNC: D1/KG/registry parity after publish.
steps.why: Website serves live D1 columns; a new-version publish is NOT live until doi + body_md + zenodo_doi + version are written (WEBSITE-SYNC-COLUMNS-1, REGISTRY-LAG-PARITY-1).
steps.scope: living-paper columns + KG node properties + program_registry.

steps.what: VERIFY LIVE: papers.qnfo.org/papers/<slug> shows the new record DOI and ZERO old-record DOI.
steps.why: Closeout claims publication completion only with the live page proof.

payload.prose: The publish pipeline is a proof chain: each step produces evidence the next step cites. No step may be skipped; the live-page verification closes the loop.
